comment: Professor McGowen is very well-versed in the political science field, but most hws/classes are spent working on contemporary politics, and his slideshows are basically pointless because he tells you the things to write down. He also couldn't finish teaching the course, but still has a full final. It should be called Intro to Contemporary Politics.

Took for intro to gov't as a senior; would not recommend. Makes such simply concepts so complicated simply because he can't get himself to stop rambling. Could never get through all the material, and ends up posting hours of Panopto videos you have to watch outside of class. Have to write 6-7 research papers that aren't hard, but take a while.

Took McGowen's campaigns and elections course. He is a good prof and knows his stuff. 5 papers (research critiques) and 2 tests made up the grade. Watched some good movies and the material was interesting. Not the fastest at responding to emails and had to cancel office hours regularly. Definitely teaches you how to think like a social scientist.

I love his personality and appreciate his conversation outside of class, but I had difficulty understanding how grades were determined in this course. We had an online exam which I found quite hard but turned out alright. I would recommend his course to others but political data science, personally, was not my cup of tea.

This was a very difficult course, not because of the content, but because of how all over the place it was. Lectures are extremely hard to follow and he tends to get off topic or switch gears often. Grading and feedback were sometimes unclear. Office hours were often very helpful, however, and I would implore anyone who takes this class to go.

Lectures are unclear and all over the place, makes the readings unnecessarily more complicated sometimes. Not good with responding to emails at all. Accessible during office hours. The assignments and homework aren't too bad. Wouldn't take him again

He is a great teacher! super helpful if you go outside of class. Not a ton of assignments but definitely have to work hard to get an A. Overall a really great class! Highly recommend that everyone takes this class and you leave a much better thinker and more knowledgeable about how to run a political science experiment.

McGowen is a pretty solid teacher. His lectures are kind of all over the place and confusing but he gives outlines which helps a lot. There's not a lot of outside of class work (we had 3 papers) and he's super accessible outside of class to help if you're confused about what to write.

Made American Government so interesting by connecting it to real events- not a ton of papers, instead your assignments are blog posts which you could definitely finish in an hour. All tests are vocabulary based so as long as you keep up with his lecture notes you're good to go.

Dr. McGowan is a great prof. His lectures are well organized and you get a great wealth of information in class. Attendance is mandatory because he gives some kind of quiz (attendance or reading) in almost every class. I really enjoyed this class and would take Dr. McGowan again

He's somewhat scatterbrained in class but does give an outline for each class period that helps. The course itself has some reading but not as much, and he's caring enough to always go over anything needed.

This class was super interesting. Professor McGowen is smart, articulate, and fun to listen to. Mainly discussion based so be prepared to talk. Tests are not too difficult as long as you show up to class and study. I would definitely recommend McGowen to anyone who is interested in political science!

I have Dr. McGowen for PLSC 220 this semester and I really like him. One thing that stood out to me was the first day of class, he made clear that he would grade based on content, and not any view you happen to side with. He is always willing to meet with students and very understanding.

A really cool guy, before class you will probably either talk about video games and sports but once it hits time for class his game face is on, he makes class very interesting, encourages participation and doesn't give a lot of homework. Test grades depend on how much you studied, not hard at all. I would definitely recommend him

I think he is a pretty good professor, even though he is hard to follow if you aren't intently paying attention.  Essentially, you can't be playing on social media and follow him at the same time.  He is always available for help to get clarification on concepts.  I hope to take him again for another class.

Great teacher, very funny and tries to make class interesting and new. I had him for into to American gov and got an A. Then i took him for Campaigns and Elections and it was a great class. Not a lot work, a fair amount of reading but he gives A LOT of credit for participation, such just talk in class and you'll be fine!
Funny and nice guy, sometimes a little confusing but he works really hard.

DO NOT TAKE HIM! Worst professor I've ever had. He is not focused in lectures and is very unclear. The midterm and final exam too long for the time frame. We were very behind in our reading throughout all of his EXTREMELY dull lectures. His grading is arbitrary-be ready for a grade that doesn't reflect your diligence.
